bugs_found: transfer allows negative amount, which credits sender and debits recipient instead of rejecting
transfer is not atomic: if crediting account_to fails after debiting account_from, balances become inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, finite, and positive; non-Decimal, NaN, or Infinity inputs can raise unexpected exceptions or corrupt balances
money functions return unquantized Decimal values with no currency rounding policy, causing precision/scale drift in production monetary amounts
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing behavior for fractional or malformed inputs instead of rejecting them
fx_convert accepts zero, negative, NaN, or infinite FX rates because rates are not validated, enabling nonsensical converted amounts
